text:
elaine (design): follow-up from design review — jotting down a handful of small compliance UI nits before we cut the feature branch. aim: clarity + a11y + minimal layout changes.

matt (frontend): please paste the problematic strings so i can update the components.

elaine (design): audit row example we currently show: `Updated retention: 90`  issues: no units, ambiguous actor, no method. propose: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by rebecca (UI)` for human rows. compact table: `Retention: 30d → 90d — rebecca (UI)`.

sarah (docs): prefer the sentence form for logs: easier to search. also recommend we store actor/method/resource as separate fields in the audit JSON payload.

rachel (security): yes backend will keep structured fields. UI must not remove method info; `by rebecca (UI)` vs `by rebecca (API)` is important. also add `severity` flag for high-impact events.

noah (a11y): accessibility nit — retention select currently shows `30 60 90` without units. Screen readers announce just numbers. please change visible options to `30 days`, `60 days`, etc. For compact displays use `30d` but ensure each has `aria-label=\"30 days\"`.

matt (frontend): trivial. i'll add i18n keys `retention.expanded.30 = \"30 days\"` and `retention.compact.30 = \"30d\"`. will wire `aria-label` to expanded key.

elaine (design): region defaulting: product wants an org-level default. two UX options discussed: (A) inline toggle `Make default for new resources` near the region picker; (B) surface a link to `Org defaults`. security prefers explicit, discoverable control. thoughts?

rachel (security): keep toggle visible. hide-in-menu is risky for audits. require `Org admin` permission to flip and add a tooltip: `Org default affects only new resources`.

noah (a11y): label text must be explicit for screen readers. use `Make this the default region for new resources` for aria-label. tooltip must be keyboard accessible (focusable trigger) and tied with `aria-describedby`.

elaine (design): noted — toggle visible + subdued styling + `aria-describedby` to tooltip. small copy: `Make this the default region for new resources (Org admins only)`. tooltip short: `Org default region determines residency for newly created dedicated deployments`.

matt (frontend): ok will implement; adding keyboard focus to tooltip trigger.

elaine (design): KMS/encryption badging: users confuse `KMS` badge meaning. proposed copy: table pill `Encrypted (Platform)` or `Encrypted (BYOK)`; resource details show `Platform-managed key` or `Customer-managed key (Bring Your Own Key)` with a link to docs.

rachel (security): agree. BYOK flow must include an explicit modal warning and a required confirmation checkbox: `I understand BYOK responsibilities and potential data unrecoverability`. Also log `BYOKEnabled` audit event including actor and workspace id.

noah (a11y): pill contrast: ensure text meets 4.5:1. don't rely on color alone to indicate BYOK. include an icon with `aria-hidden=true` and accessible text `Encryption type: Customer-managed key` exposed for screen readers.

sarah (docs): tooltip copy suggestions: short: `Platform-managed key (Redwood)` and `Customer-managed key (You manage the key)`. modal body: `If you enable BYOK and later revoke or delete the key, encrypted data may become unrecoverable. Org admins only.`

elaine (design): confirmation modal copy for retention changes also needs strengthening. current: `Are you sure? This will change retention.` replace with: `Change retention to 90 days for Workspace X? Messages older than 90 days may be permanently deleted.` secondary link: `Review data lifecycle docs`

rachel (security): add a checkbox when shrinking retention: `I understand this may permanently delete messages older than the new retention period` before enabling. and log `RetentionReducedConfirmed`.

matt (frontend): will add modal with disabled CTA until checkbox checked. adding analytics events `retention_change_requested` and `retention_change_confirmed`.

infra-bot: scheduled staging deploy for `compliance-ui/v3` on 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z :rocket:

elaine (design): export CSV structure request: customers asked for `field_changed, old_value, new_value, actor, method, resource_id, timestamp, severity, meta_json`. please ensure meta_json is optional and permissioned.

rachel (security): exports gated to org_admin/compliance roles and redaction rules apply. meta_json must be reviewed for PII before GA. add an audit event when export is downloaded: `AuditExportDownloaded` with user and applied filters.

sarah (docs): will update export docs with column examples and a redaction note. avoid `from`/`to` column names; prefer `old_value`/`new_value`.

noah (a11y): CSV export modal must be keyboard-accessible and the warning text visible without color cues.

elaine (design): last tiny item: the KMS pill link text should be descriptive not `learn more`. use `Learn about key ownership`.

matt (frontend): summarized action items: add i18n keys, update select labels + aria-labels, implement pills + contrast, add BYOK modal + checkbox, strengthen retention modal + checkbox, add analytics hooks, add audit export hook. i'll open PR today.

rachel (security): i'll review BYOK + export redaction before merge.

sarah (docs): i'll push doc updates and sample audit CSV lines.

elaine (design): great. i'll upload the updated artboard and short note with the exact text strings. thanks! :seedling:
